adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, new logic was added that immediately performs a refresh-token POST to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` and then `prisma.credential.update(...)` before creating the `jsforce.Connection`. The diff shows no gating based on an expiry timestamp/`issued_at`/`expires_in`, so this refresh+DB write will occur every time this code path runs (i.e., whenever the service establishes a connection), which is a concrete latency and write-amplification concern introduced by the change. Whether it's a correctness “bug” depends on runtime usage patterns, but the unconditional refresh is clearly present in the diff.
